question: Can a fixed, past-only local linear FER forecast improve receding-horizon routing over last-observation snapshot routing in the already inspected public SafeStep fire?
evidence_status: Development / method feasibility on one already inspected fire; no new independent confirmation data
starts: All 61 archived nonexit movement cells, equally weighted within departure

movement.constraints: Same legal cardinal moves, first exit arrival terminal, no wait, revisits allowed; shrinking remaining horizon 45-k for all online methods

observations.available: Exact global region FER native rows timestamp <= decision time; retain native timestamps; never interpolate an online measurement with a later row
observations.predeparture_history: All methods may access the same predeparture history; forecast uses only a fixed recent window
observations.noise: None in primary and sensitivity stages
observations.information_exclusion: No future rows, full-fire normalization, future-fitted parameters, or original DQN checkpoint passed to online planners

primary_methods.role: causal snapshot baseline; last available measurement held constant
primary forecast; OLS slope over seven native samples, anchored to latest sample
predeclared secondary damped forecast, not tuned after results

forecast.equation: max(0, latest_rate + slope_gain * OLS_slope * min(query_time - latest_observed_time, projection_cap_s)); hold at cap thereafter
forecast.cap_interpretation: Maximum trend extrapolation duration, measured from latest observation; planning continues to the same episode deadline
forecast.nonnegativity: Clip predicted rate at zero; integrate zero-crossing and cap analytically
forecast.planner: Backward time-expanded dynamic programming; minimum predicted FED, then fewer moves, then left/right/up/down action order; execute first action and replan
forecast.ground_truth_scoring: Independent evaluator integrates piecewise-linear original public FER over departure-cell residence, charging initial interval once, no predeparture or exit dose

stages.primary: All three online methods plus full-future reference: 2196 cached-table rollouts; report all departures and all cases
stages.sensitivity: Run the four fixed sensitivity methods only if any primary forecast has at least 1% lower mean FED at at least one departure, with all 61 arrivals there. Do not select a new primary method.
stages.noise: Deferred; no automatic noise sweep or enlarged training in this bounded task
stages.stop: After implementation checks, primary results, triggered fixed sensitivity and one report; no result-dependent parameter search

analysis.failure: Report arrivals first. Successful FED and paired differences use jointly reached cases; no partial-dose credit for failure.
analysis.action_diagnostic: At each visited forecast state where its first action differs from the snapshot action at the same state/time, score one forecast action followed by the snapshot policy to the episode deadline. Label harmful/helpful/neutral relative to snapshot continuation. These overlapping counterfactuals are not independent outcomes and are not summed into a causal total.
analysis.forecast_error: MAE and RMSE over 58 unique regions at 10/30/60 s ahead, computed after policies are frozen; no cell-duplication weighting or fitting
analysis.reference: Privileged full-future finite-horizon minimum-FED; compare to cached values within 1e-10; not an online competitor
analysis.timing: Wall time for each global all-state first-action solve, with method order randomized by fixed seed; identical solver and remaining horizon. Reuse global policy tables across starts; do not count timing as 61 independent calls.
analysis.statistics: Descriptive only; one fire, repeated start-times, no independent-fire confidence intervals or significance tests
analysis.continuation_decision: Any benefit is feasibility evidence only. New independent physical conditions are required before generalization or introducing an LLM method. Explicitly report any increased FED and any failure.

verification: Changing unseen future rows cannot change available prefix, predicted costs or first actions
Native off-grid observations use last available row, never a future endpoint
Analytic forecast integral matches independent numerical integration including zero crossing and cap
Constant histories reduce trend to snapshot and produce the same actions
Remaining horizon enforces terminal reachability and never credits an incomplete path
Ground-truth oracle matches archived benchmark values and every reached route is bounded below by it
Common measurement history and solver constraints across online methods
All frozen source and previous-result file hashes verified before and after
